figures.title: Чертёж зажима натяжного прессуемого типа НМЗ
figures.description: Main side view of the clamp with a closed loop eye at the right: L is overall length from the left (threaded/socket) end to the right extremity; L1 is measured from the left end to a step on the shank; L2 is measured along the loop eye; d1 is the inner diameter of the loop eye; d denotes the hole/cable diameter at the left end; A labels the section cut location on the shank. Below: section A-A «иСПОЛНЕНИЕ 1» — round cross-section with outside diameter D and hole d; section A-A «иСПОЛНЕНИЕ 2» — flattened cross-section with width B, outside diameter D and hole d. The exact geometric meaning of label A beyond the cut plane is not stated on the drawing.

source_notes: Разрушающая нагрузка дана «не менее», в кН; масса в кг (per printed headers).
uncertainties: Units for columns B, D, d, d1, L, L1, L2 are not printed in the table; likely millimetres per drawing convention but not stated on the page.

Printed values 50 (L, НМЗ-240-1), 23 (L1, НМЗ-240-3), 29 (L1, НМЗ-350-3) and cable marks «Р1770» (НМЗ-70-1) and «Р-170» (НМЗ-180-2) appear truncated in print; transcribed literally without correction.
Merged-cell extents (e.g. breaking load 160 spanning НМЗ-60 and НМЗ-70; mass 4,52 spanning НМЗ-110 and НМЗ-120) were read visually; exact span boundaries carry minor uncertainty.
